from pathlib import Path
import re
from collections import Counter
root=Path('/workspace/product/history')
terms=re.compile(r'Focus Shelf|Sunday Room|status filters|triage facets|quiet digest|weekly note',re.I)
exact=re.compile(r'Android 15|280.person|34 tasks|50,000|legacy per-user|legacy contributor|contributor-level|mobile',re.I)
variants=[]
for p in root.rglob('*.md'):
 t=p.read_text()
 if 'Alias used in the design review:' in t and terms.search(t): variants.append((p,t))
print('Similarly named variant actions:',len(variants))
print('Their stated cohorts:',dict(Counter(re.search(r'Cohort: (.*?)\\. This action',t).group(1) for _,t in variants)))
matches=[str(p) for p,t in variants if exact.search(t)]
print('Variants matching specific current conditions or known root-cause phrases:',matches)
print('September operations files:',[str(p) for p in (root/'operations').glob('*.md') if re.search(r'2026-09|September',p.read_text(),re.I)])
PY"

from pathlib import Path
import re
p=Path('/workspace/work/decision.md')
t=p.read_text()
links=re.findall(r'\\]\\((/workspace/["'^)]+)'"\\)',t)
missing=[x for x in links if not Path(x).is_file()]
ids=set(re.findall(r'record-[0-9a-f]{10}',t))
sources='\\n'.join(x+'\\n'+Path(x).read_text() for x in set(links))
unmatched=sorted(x for x in ids if x not in sources)
assert not missing, missing
assert not unmatched, unmatched
print(f'Verified {len(links)} source links and {len(ids)} source IDs in {p}.')
PY"
